name: revamp-monorepo
description: Revamp SaaS - Automated Website Audit and MVP Redesign Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@revamp/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@revamp/validation
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@revamp/api && npm run build --workspace=@revamp/workers && npm run build --workspace=@revamp/dashboard
